ios.desc:
Learn languages, or study for school and tests, with the most powerful and user-friendly flashcard app. Millions of language-learners and students have studied over 2 billion flashcards with AlgoApp. Ranked #1 Education app in multiple countries world-wide. Featured in the New York Times.

Designed by learning experts, including a published neuroscientist. Whether you're learning a language to live somewhere new or just for fun, need to get through med school, or just want to crush your tests, AlgoApp has already done it for over 5 million people.

Why AlgoApp?

FOR LANGUAGE LEARNERS
• Automatic translation. Make vocab flashcards faster by typing words in the language you know, then AlgoApp translates to the language you're learning (or vice versa). Supports 120 languages including Japanese, Chinese, Korean, English, German, French, and more...

• Speaks flashcards to you, in dozens of languages (automatic text-to-speech). Supports 39 languages including Japanese, Chinese, Korean, English, German, French, and more...

• Automatically generates furigana annotations for kanji, or pinyin annotations for hanzi.

FOR STUDENTS
• Converts PDFs directly into flashcards using AI. Upload lecture slides and have a full deck of flashcards ready in seconds.

• Prompt AI to make flashcards for you based on text and pictures. Turns handwritten notes and diagrams into flash cards for you.

• Format your cards with colored text, bulleted lists, underlines, and more (no CSS needed).

• Works offline, so you can study and make cards even when you don't have signal.

• Syncs automatically with desktop, web app, and your other phones and tablets. So you can make cards on a computer with a full keyboard, then study on your phone.

• Natively supports FSRS, the most-advanced spaced repetition algorithm.

• Imports Anki decks (.apkg), AlgoApp (.xml) files, or spreadsheets (.csv).

• Supports folders and subfolders, to keep your classes organized.

• Notifications tell you when it's time to study (opt-in).

• Share decks and study with your friends using Study Groups.

• No ads.

For the most-dedicated students, try AlgoApp Unlimited free for 7 days. Study as much as you want on all your devices.

If you want to upgrade to AlgoApp Unlimited, you can either purchase "Unlimited: 1-Year" which is a 1-year auto-renewing subscription, or "Unlimited: Lifetime" which is a one-time purchase.
• Unlimited grants you access to unlimited cross-platform multi-device sync, and more..

quotes.text:
Not much to it. I use an app on iOS called 'AnkiApp'

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ankiapp-flashcards/id689185915

I just read for an hour every morning, and once the chapter is complete, I go back through the chapter and create Anki flashcards for 30 mins, then study the cards I just created for 30 mins.

So right now my professor will be lecturing us on Chapters 7 and 10 next week on November 18. I did an hour of reading for chapter 10 today. I'll finish Chapter 10 and Chapter 7 by next week on the 17th.

So far, I've covered the material once: I read the chapter.

When my professor lectures us next week, I'll take detailed notes over the material. I write all my notes by hand.

So far, I've covered the material TWICE: I just took notes during lecture

Next week, since I finished Chapter 7 and 10 already, I'll continue my one hour routine every morning, but I'll do 30 minutes of creating Anki flashcards, and 30 minutes of studying those flashcards. Each time I perform an Anki session, it would be my THIRD time going over the material. Each additional time I study an Anki deck, the number increases.

I also realized that I become so much more productive when I started studying/reading first thing in the morning - I have the most energy, and it gives me that "Let's get this done and over with" mentality.
